records.description: Brave launched a browser-native self-custody wallet built directly into the Brave desktop browser, replacing extension dependence for Brave's primary built-in wallet path while allowing users to import from the legacy Crypto Wallets extension.
records.notes: This is retained as material product-history depth because Brave explicitly introduced a new browser-native wallet boundary with no extension required and documented migration/import from its legacy Crypto Wallets extension. It is not a generic launch added solely to reduce the zero-event count. Mobile availability was still future-facing in this launch announcement and is not included in the affected product scope.
records.title: Browser-native Brave Wallet launched

records.notes: Current first-party Brave page identifies Brave Wallet as a self-custody wallet built directly into Brave and available on major devices.
records.title: Brave Wallet - Secure Crypto Wallet

records.notes: First-party help center confirms browser-native self-custody and desktop/mobile usage.
records.title: What is Brave Wallet?

records.notes: First-party Brave launch post states that Brave Wallet launched on 2021-11-16 as a browser-native desktop wallet requiring no extension and documents import from Brave's legacy Crypto Wallets extension.
records.title: Introducing the Brave Wallet, a Browser-Native Crypto Wallet With No Extension Required
